cards.title: Power BI: reports refreshed for nobody
cards.headline: 21 of 60 reports are refreshed daily but opened fewer than 30 times a year; with 4 copies and 4 quarterly reports they use 79% of the refresh load. The capacity costs CHF 24,084 a year whatever runs on it.

potential.action: clean up the reports, then move the capacity one tier down
potential.decided_by: Head of IT + Head of Finance
potential.note: upper bound if acted on; not additive with the package (the advisor decides, code computes)

protected: pbi-07 «Legacy report receivables»: keep as is (regulatory / ticket) (T-1167)

calc.formula: clean-up: refresh minutes of unused reports and copies removed, quarterly reports keep 1/3; capacity utilisation ∝ refresh load (engine: 8 v-cores, 25 GB, 50 %); downsizing: half the v-cores and memory, cost × 0.5 (ASSUMPTION: capacity price ∝ capacity units)

steps.note: less load, same bill: saves energy and CO2 only

steps.decided_by: Head of IT + Head of Finance
steps.note: price assumed proportional to capacity units (verify on the Azure price page); a paused pay-as-you-go capacity also stops compute billing (Microsoft Learn: pause and resume)

cards.title: Where else could it run?
cards.headline: 8 regions of our providers are available but unused (e.g. AWS Zurich). Largest single gain: dp-dev DE → CH, 863 kg CO2 a year.

numbers.label: relocation options with a CO2 gain

calc.formula: CO2 saved = recurring kWh × (grid at today's location − grid at the other location of the same provider)

cards.safety_rule: The advisor may only relocate a load to a location its provider offers (checked by code).

cards.title: Data platform: tables nobody reads
cards.headline: 9.2 TB of 27.6 TB are unread for a year or temporary and not under retention (33% of the stored volume); 3.9 TB need an owner's answer on retention.

potential.action: archive or delete unread and temporary tables
potential.note: upper bound if acted on; not additive with the package (the advisor decides, code computes)

protected: tables with retention_required = yes stay, even if never read

calc.formula: share = GB of (unread > 1 year or schema tmp) without retention / catalogue GB; catalogue GB = dp-storage GB-days / 365 (checked in reconcile); potential = share × dp-storage

cards.title: Logs kept for a year
cards.headline: 68% of the log volume is kept 365 days. Keeping 90 days unless a service needs more would cut the stored log volume by 69%.

potential.action: default retention 90 days, longer only where required
potential.note: upper bound if acted on; not additive with the package (the advisor decides, code computes)

protected: services with a legal or security retention need keep theirs (to be confirmed per service)

calc.formula: stored GB ∝ Σ volume × retention days; share = 1 − Σ volume × min(retention, 90) / Σ volume × retention

cards.title: Builds that change nothing
cards.headline: 21% of the nightly builds run with no new commit; skipping them saves 3.2% of all build minutes. All builds run in aws-eu-west-1 (Dublin).

potential.action: skip the nightly build when nothing changed
potential.note: upper bound if acted on; not additive with the package (the advisor decides, code computes)

calc.formula: share = build seconds of nightly builds with 0 commits since the last one / all build seconds; runner minutes are billed (2 × build time, checked in reconcile)

cards.title: AI agents: reports nobody opens
cards.headline: 91% of the report-agent's reports are never opened; generating them on request would remove most of its usage. The research-agent retries 1.6 times per run on average.

potential.action: report-agent on request instead of on schedule
potential.note: upper bound if acted on; not additive with the package (the advisor decides, code computes)

calc.formula: share of report-agent runs whose report was never opened × ai-report recurring baseline

cards.title: Web traffic: a third are bots
cards.headline: 36% of the delivered web volume goes to bots (sampled data scaled ×10).

potential.action: block or rate-limit unwanted bots (keep search engines)
potential.note: upper bound if acted on; not additive with the package (the advisor decides, code computes)

protected: useful bots (search engines, monitoring) must keep access

calc.formula: bot share = Σ bot % × GB / Σ GB (sample rate applied); upper bound: all bot traffic removed

cards.title: Backups: three tools, legal retention
cards.headline: 21 of 36 sources are backed up by all three tools (15% of backup volume in third copies), and 29 copies have never been restore-tested. The archive is under a 10-year legal retention: deletion is blocked.

potential.action: drop third copies (only where no retention applies)
potential.note: upper bound if acted on; not additive with the package (the advisor decides, code computes)

calc.formula: share = GB of the third copy of sources in 3 tools / all backup GB

cards.title: Closed projects still running
cards.headline: 4 completed projects still have resources billing after their end: CHF 27,095 and 735 kg CO2 in the baseline year (largest: P-004 Internal AI pilot, ended 2025-06-30).

numbers.label: completed projects with costs after the end

potential.action: confirm with the project owner, then switch off or re-assign
potential.note: upper bound if acted on; not additive with the package (the advisor decides, code computes)

calc.formula: Σ baseline lines tagged with a completed project and dated after its end

cards.title: CO2 per client project
cards.headline: Client projects caused 531 kg CO2 in the baseline year; about 423 kg belong to rechargeable work and can be reported to the clients (Scope 3 for them).

calc.formula: project = tagged lines + Σ months, departments: untagged department lines × project hours / (FTE × 182 h); time not booked on projects stays unassigned

cards.allocation_note: Departments are allocated directly (tags, cost centers, mapping); no shared Overhead remains, so FTE vs hours makes no difference there. Hours are used for the project view.

cards.title: Microsoft 365: real use vs licences
cards.headline: Admin data shows 104 active users vs 102 active licences (+2%): the licence data is confirmed; 11% of the purchased seats are unused. Bottom-up energy 100 kWh/year (range 33–4,595) vs 184 kWh in our baseline: consistent.

calc.formula: licences: mean weekly active users vs mean monthly active licences; energy: storage GB-days × storage factor + video minutes × kWh/min (data volume × network factor; high: Obringer et al. 2021)

sources: Obringer et al. 2021, Resources, Conservation & Recycling 167

used_for: advisor safety rule: only offered regions
card project_footprint (CO2 per client project, hours as allocation key)
